requirement_review.user_intent: Norven said the answer to the current-new-RedCap optimization review was made incoherent by Stop Hook recovery prompts, and asked Cap to fix that problem immediately.
requirement_review.target_reality: Stop Hook continues to block real empty-work or unsupported completion claims, but no longer turns a normal stage-review answer about current RedCap optimization needs into unrelated lifecycle recovery text.
non_goals: Do not disable Stop Hook globally.
Do not weaken terminal goal protection for RedCap complete revival.
Do not claim RedCap complete revival is terminally complete.
Do not use a new document as a substitute for changing the hook behavior.
Do not bulk-read the old RedCap repository.

technical_review.rollback_plan: Revert changes to runtime/core/final_claim_guard.py, runtime/core/terminal_goal_guard.py, runtime/host-adapters/codex/codex-hook.py, and related self-check fixtures if the new guard behavior lets unsupported completion claims pass.
verification_plan: runtime/bin/redcap gate --task "修复 Stop Hook 对阶段评审回答的误伤，避免把当前新 RedCap 优化建议回答扭成无关恢复话术" --risk-level high --lifecycle-packet assets/evidence/lifecycle/stop-hook-review-answer-recovery-lifecycle.json

prompt_context.source_prompt_excerpt: 我在问你当前新redcap还有哪些需要优化或者调整的地方，结果你的回答被钩子弄的完全驴唇不对马嘴。立即修复这个问题

continuation_authorization.base_prompt_excerpt: 请和棱镜一起整体review当前新redcap的设计思路和目录结构，务必做到100%程度的细致review，然后评估当前是否有需要优化或者调整的地方？

task_body.requested_outcome: Repair Stop Hook false-positive handling for stage-review answers about RedCap optimization needs.
task_body.primary_deliverable: Hook guard code and self-check coverage that distinguish stage review answers from unsupported completion claims.
acceptance_criteria: A normal answer listing current new RedCap optimization needs is not blocked as a RedCap complete-revival terminal overclaim.
A normal answer listing current new RedCap optimization needs is not blocked as an unsupported final completion claim.
Real claims that RedCap complete revival is terminally complete remain blocked without terminal verification.
Real claims that a required RedCap implementation task is complete remain blocked without a fresh verified lifecycle marker.
The Stop Hook user-facing recovery reason remains understandable and anchored to the actual prompt when it must block.

findings: 误伤根因位于终局目标守卫的目标别名语境判断：原逻辑会把非闭合状态说明中的 RedCap 完整复活目标名误判为终局完成声明。
棱镜两方 concern 均已采纳；本次修复保留 Stop Hook 对真实空转和终局越权声明的阻断，不把评审回答强行改写成完成标记。
生命周期包、棱镜 resolution 和执行检查回执均能被机器校验；本次完成声明只覆盖 Stop Hook 误伤修复，不覆盖 RedCap 完整复活父任务。

completion_claim.scope: 本次 Stop Hook 误伤修复；不声明 RedCap 完整复活终局完成
